runs.title: Surface failures are current; broad model decline remains unproven
runs.summary: A fresh public-source review found active ChatGPT upload and image failures, a resolved 3 September outage cluster, narrow Grok gibberish reports, and task-level complaints that remain confounded.

runs.title: Incidents resolved; rollout and route changes still make quality hard to generalize
runs.summary: The latest provider checks are operational, while official model changes, a nominal scoped coding tracker, current leaderboards, and mixed task reports sharpen the distinction between reliability, routing, field outcomes, and broad capability.

runs.title: The newest lead is a route, not a model collapse
runs.summary: Provider documentation makes fallback and allowance confounders explicit; a technically detailed but unconfirmed Gemini route report sharpens the next test; scoped trackers still do not prove broad capability decline.

runs.title: Astra/Codex has an incident cluster; core decline remains unproven
runs.summary: Fresh open Codex reports add a detailed Astra agent-behavior, safety, orchestration, and quota incident cluster. Aggregate status and rolling field outcomes remain counterweights, so the verdict narrows to a real user-facing incident without proving core capability regression.

runs.title: Astra is not broadly worse; the system around it is failing in public
runs.summary: OpenAI confirmed a recent usage-limit incident, a fresh desktop transport report separates web from client behavior, and a current Project-link incident adds product context. The field panel remains strong but costly and rolling, so the verdict stays narrow: specific surfaces are different, blocked, or expensive; broad capability decline is unproven.
